styles.prompt: Image 1 is a photo of the real dog Linda (a fluffy white Bichon-type poodle with round cloud-like head, long drop ears, dark eyes, black nose, tongue out): keep her likeness. Image 2 shows only the layout wanted (front head left, full sitting body right). Make the set of Linda as an alebrije. ALEBRIJE FOLK-ART STYLE (Mexican alebrije, Oaxacan painted-wood-carving look): vivid saturated colors (magenta, turquoise, orange, sunny yellow, lime green, purple, hot pink, cobalt blue) in flat solid fills, every color region separated by a bold black outline so it prints cleanly and stays vivid on both white and black shirts. The body, ears and curly topknot are covered in intricate hand-painted alebrije patterns: dots, concentric swirls, stripes, zigzags, tiny flowers, leaf scrolls and scales, each area a different pattern and color. Joyful, festive and ornate but the dog stays clearly and instantly recognizable, with friendly dark eyes with white catchlights and a happy open mouth. Flat colors only, no gradients, no shading, no shadows, no frame, no text or letters, on a flat pure white background. Layout: a small FRONT chest emblem (head only) on the left and the matching full-body sitting BACK print on the right, both in exactly the same alebrije style and palette so they are one coherent set. Pure pattern variant: no extra creature parts.
